request: I help run a trotro station in Accra and I want to keep our routes and fares in one place. Each route goes between two stops, for example Circle to Madina, and has a fare in cedis. I want to add routes and see all of them. Passengers should be able to find out how much it costs to go from one stop to another. Fares go up from time to time, so I need to be able to change the fare of a route.
summary:
I've built the routes-and-fares system in `app.py`, and all 11 tests I wrote for it pass. Routes are saved in a file called `trotro.db` in the same folder.

**Before you use it:** only staff can add routes or change fares. They prove they're staff by sending a secret password (called a "key") with each request, in a field named `X-Staff-Key`. You set this password in a setting called `STAFF_KEY` before starting the app. If you don't set it, the app falls back to the password `change-me-staff-key`. Anyone who knows that default could change your fares, so please set your own.

**Endpoints**
- **POST /routes** (staff only): adds a route. You send `start_stop`, `end_stop` and `fare`, and get back the route with its route number and the date and time it was last changed.
- **GET /routes** (anyone): lists all saved routes with their stops and fares.
- **GET /fares?from=STOP&to=STOP** (anyone): gives the fare between two stops, or says no such route is saved.
- **PATCH /routes/{route number}/fare** (staff only): changes one route's fare by sending `{"fare": new amount}`. It also updates the "last changed" time.

**Rules it enforces**
- Every route must have a starting stop, an ending stop and a fare.
- The starting and ending stop can't be the same stop.
- The fare must be more than zero, with at most two digits after the decimal point (whole pesewas).
- The same route can't be added twice. To change its price, update the fare instead.
- Stop names match whether or not you use capital letters or extra spaces, so "circle " and "Circle" count as the same stop.
- Changing a fare for a route number that doesn't exist is refused.
- If someone who isn't staff tries to add a route or change a fare, they get an error saying only station staff can do this.

**One choice I made:** a route goes one way only. Circle → Madina and Madina → Circle count as two separate routes, so each direction can have its own fare and needs to be added on its own.

plan.summary: This plan sets up a simple system for your trotro station to keep all routes and fares in one place. Each route records the two stops it runs between (for example, Circle to Madina) and the fare in cedis. You will be able to add new routes, see a list of all routes, and change a route's fare when prices go up. Passengers will be able to type in a starting stop and an ending stop and find out how much the trip costs. Everything you asked for is included, and nothing was left out.

data.name: Route
fields: Route number: a unique number the system gives each route automatically so it can be found and updated
Starting stop: the name of the stop where the route begins, for example Circle
Ending stop: the name of the stop where the route ends, for example Madina
Fare: the price of the trip in cedis, for example 8.50
Last updated: the date and time the route or its fare was last changed

endpoints.does: Adds a new route. You give the starting stop, the ending stop, and the fare in cedis, and the system saves it and gives it a route number.
Shows the full list of all saved routes with their stops and fares.
Lets a passenger find the fare between two stops. They give a starting stop and an ending stop, and the system replies with the fare in cedis, or says no such route is saved.
Changes the fare of one existing route to a new amount in cedis, for example when fares go up.

rules: A route cannot be saved unless it has a starting stop, an ending stop, and a fare.
The starting stop and the ending stop cannot be the same stop.
The fare must be a number greater than zero, in cedis, with no more than two digits after the decimal point (pesewas).
The same route (same starting stop and same ending stop) cannot be added twice; to change its price, update the fare instead.
Stop names are matched without caring about capital letters or extra spaces, so 'circle' and 'Circle ' count as the same stop.
Changing a fare is refused if the route number does not exist.
Only station staff can add routes or change fares; passengers can only look up fares and see routes.
